cards.title: GOAT
cards.head: You sit with the year's ruler.
cards.body: Good for owning your path. Go easy on big risks.

cards.title: OX
cards.head: The year pushes against you.
cards.body: Great for moves and change. Don't force fights.

cards.title: RAT
cards.head: Little misunderstandings creep in.
cards.body: Say it twice, kindly. Trust grows from it.

cards.title: DOG
cards.head: Old rules and routines may crack.
cards.body: Good to rebuild habits. Count to ten first.

cta.line: Not one of the four? Check anyway.
cta.sub: Your year animal is only part of your chart.

caption:
Tag your Goat, Ox, Rat and Dog friends 🐐🐂🐀🐕

Every year has a ruler, the Tai Sui. In 2027 it's the Goat. Goats sit with the ruler, Oxen clash with it, Rats and Dogs rub against it. Tradition calls this 'meeting the Tai Sui'. It isn't bad luck: it's a year to move with care, and each of the four has a real upside too.

Born in January or early February? Your animal may be the year before. Get your free chart at skyandseason.com (link in bio), open Calendar, go to February 2027 and see your own 2027 mark: Good, Steady or Care, for work, money and love.

Which animal are you? Comment below.
